name: Nantianmen
description: This region notably features the Dragon-Queller, a large tree used to seal Azhdaha, whom Jiu worships. The dragon has begun merging with the tree, using its roots to connect to the ley lines and draw power from them. At the tip of the tree is a large blue branch, which points directly towards Liyue Harbor. That portion of the tree also cannot be climbed on.
